indexes.indexdef: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX image_conversation_events_pkey ON public.image_conversation_events USING btree (conversation_id, seq)
CREATE INDEX image_events_retention ON public.image_conversation_events USING btree (created_at)
CREATE INDEX image_events_turn ON public.image_conversation_events USING btree (turn_id) WHERE (turn_id IS NOT NULL)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX image_conversation_messages_pkey ON public.image_conversation_messages USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX image_messages_one_user_per_turn ON public.image_conversation_messages USING btree (turn_id) WHERE (role = 'user'::text)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX image_messages_sequence ON public.image_conversation_messages USING btree (conversation_id, seq)
CREATE INDEX image_messages_turn ON public.image_conversation_messages USING btree (turn_id) WHERE (turn_id IS NOT NULL)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX image_conversation_turns_pkey ON public.image_conversation_turns USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX image_conversation_turns_task_id_key ON public.image_conversation_turns USING btree (task_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX image_conversation_turns_task_request_id_key ON public.image_conversation_turns USING btree (task_request_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX image_turns_client_request ON public.image_conversation_turns USING btree (owner_user_id, client_request_id)
CREATE INDEX image_turns_conversation_history ON public.image_conversation_turns USING btree (conversation_id, created_at DESC, id DESC)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX image_turns_conversation_identity ON public.image_conversation_turns USING btree (conversation_id, id)

CREATE INDEX image_turns_planner_recovery ON public.image_conversation_turns USING btree (state, planner_lease_expires_at, updated_at) WHERE (state = ANY (ARRAY['accepted'::text, 'planning'::text, 'uncertain'::text]))

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX image_turns_single_flight ON public.image_conversation_turns USING btree (conversation_id) WHERE (state = ANY (ARRAY['accepted'::text, 'planning'::text, 'queued'::text, 'generating'::text, 'uncertain'::text]))

CREATE INDEX image_turns_task_reconciliation ON public.image_conversation_turns USING btree (state, updated_at) WHERE ((task_id IS NOT NULL) AND (state = ANY (ARRAY['queued'::text, 'generating'::text, 'uncertain'::text, 'detached'::text])))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX image_conversation_versions_pkey ON public.image_conversation_versions USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX image_versions_asset ON public.image_conversation_versions USING btree (asset_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX image_versions_conversation_identity ON public.image_conversation_versions USING btree (conversation_id, id)
CREATE INDEX image_versions_history ON public.image_conversation_versions USING btree (conversation_id, image_no)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX image_versions_image_number ON public.image_conversation_versions USING btree (conversation_id, image_no)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX image_versions_root_identity ON public.image_conversation_versions USING btree (conversation_id, root_version_id, id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX image_versions_root_number ON public.image_conversation_versions USING btree (conversation_id, root_version_id, version_no)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX image_versions_turn_output ON public.image_conversation_versions USING btree (turn_id, output_index) WHERE (source = 'generated'::text)
CREATE INDEX image_conversations_canvas ON public.image_conversations USING btree (owner_user_id, canvas_external_id) WHERE (canvas_external_id IS NOT NULL)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX image_conversations_create_request ON public.image_conversations USING btree (owner_user_id, create_request_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX image_conversations_owner_identity ON public.image_conversations USING btree (id, owner_user_id)
CREATE INDEX image_conversations_owner_list ON public.image_conversations USING btree (owner_user_id, created_at DESC, id DESC)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX image_conversations_pkey ON public.image_conversations USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX image_conversations_project ON public.image_conversations USING btree (project_uuid) WHERE (project_uuid IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: image_conversation_events_conversation_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (conversation_id) REFERENCES image_conversations(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: image_events_turn_same_conversation
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (conversation_id, turn_id) REFERENCES image_conversation_turns(conversation_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: image_conversation_messages_conversation_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (conversation_id) REFERENCES image_conversations(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: image_messages_content
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((text IS NOT NULL) AND (char_length(text) > 0)) OR (jsonb_array_length(attachments) > 0)))

constraints.name: image_messages_turn_same_conversation
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (conversation_id, turn_id) REFERENCES image_conversation_turns(conversation_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: image_conversation_turns_owner_user_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (owner_user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: image_conversation_turns_task_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (task_id) REFERENCES tasks(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: image_conversation_turns_task_request_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (task_request_id) REFERENCES tasks(request_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: image_turns_base_same_conversation
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (conversation_id, base_version_id) REFERENCES image_conversation_versions(conversation_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: image_turns_dispatch_metadata
constraints.definition: CHECK (((planner_status <> ALL (ARRAY['in_flight'::text, 'unknown'::text])) OR ((planner_request_id IS NOT NULL) AND (planner_dispatch_started_at IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: image_turns_input_active_same_conversation
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (conversation_id, input_active_version_id) REFERENCES image_conversation_versions(conversation_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: image_turns_nonimage_no_task
constraints.definition: CHECK (((intent IS NULL) OR (intent <> ALL (ARRAY['discuss'::text, 'clarify'::text, 'restore'::text])) OR ((task_id IS NULL) AND (task_request_id IS NULL))))

constraints.name: image_turns_output_same_conversation
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (conversation_id, output_version_id) REFERENCES image_conversation_versions(conversation_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: image_turns_owner_conversation
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (conversation_id, owner_user_id) REFERENCES image_conversations(id, owner_user_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: image_turns_reply_same_conversation
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (conversation_id, reply_to_turn_id) REFERENCES image_conversation_turns(conversation_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: image_conversation_versions_asset_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (asset_id) REFERENCES assets(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: image_conversation_versions_conversation_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (conversation_id) REFERENCES image_conversations(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: image_versions_parent_same_root
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (conversation_id, root_version_id, parent_version_id) REFERENCES image_conversation_versions(conversation_id, root_version_id, id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED

constraints.name: image_versions_root_same_conversation
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (conversation_id, root_version_id) REFERENCES image_conversation_versions(conversation_id, id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED

constraints.name: image_versions_root_shape
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((parent_version_id IS NULL) AND (root_version_id = id) AND (version_no = 1)) OR ((parent_version_id IS NOT NULL) AND (parent_version_id <> id) AND (root_version_id <> id) AND (version_no > 1))))

constraints.name: image_versions_source_shape
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((source = 'upload'::text) AND (turn_id IS NULL) AND (parameters IS NULL) AND (parent_version_id IS NULL)) OR ((source = 'generated'::text) AND (turn_id IS NOT NULL) AND (parameters IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: image_versions_turn_same_conversation
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (conversation_id, turn_id) REFERENCES image_conversation_turns(conversation_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: image_conversations_active_same_conversation
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (id, active_version_id) REFERENCES image_conversation_versions(conversation_id, id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED

constraints.name: image_conversations_canvas_binding
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((entrypoint = 'standalone'::text) AND (canvas_external_id IS NULL)) OR ((entrypoint = 'canvas'::text) AND (canvas_external_id IS NOT NULL) AND (char_length(canvas_external_id) > 0))))

constraints.name: image_conversations_canvas_owner
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (owner_user_id, canvas_external_id) REFERENCES canvas_documents(owner_user_id, external_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: image_conversations_owner_user_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (owner_user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: image_conversations_project_uuid_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (project_uuid) REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

modelTrigger.name: model_public_number_before_write
modelTrigger.definition: CREATE TRIGGER model_public_number_before_write BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.model_configs FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION assign_model_public_number()
